title: Matriculation Announcement
excerpt: Announcement of the 76th matriculation date for all freshers
body:
Greetings to all students of this noble university. We hope we all are doing just fine by His grace.

This announcement is from the authorities of the school's management and as today mark the 28th day in the month October, 2026, the school wish to bring this particular message on board to be conveyed to all students of the university. There has been an update on the date chosen for the years' 76th matriculation as the previous announced date has been rescheduled to happen on the **12th day of November, 2026**. Therefore all matriculants are required to attend rehearsal on the day before the actual fixed date. 

Take note:
1. Matriculation gown for the ceremony shall be provided to all matriculants on the same day of the rehearsal.
2. An official oath shall taken and signed online on the student portals.
3. All matriculants must take and sign the online oath found on their portals at the given period of 1 day. Failure to comply shall automatically withdraw your position as a student in the university.
4. Just after the event, all gowns collected must be returned to the appropriate faculties.
5. In a case of thorning the gown shall attract a severe penalty of huge sum of *GHS 5000.00* to be paid to officials in charge.

We encourage you to read with rapt attention so you do not fall a victim.
Thank you all!
